paragraphs: Rabbi Elazar ben Daglai, Tamid 3:8, 30: “Father had goats on Mount Mikhvar; they sneezed from the incense’s fragrance.” Jerusalem Talmud, Hechalil, halakhah 3: ben Dalgai. Perhaps the above ben Dola'ai.
